gloss: general affairs; clerical work; miscellaneous office duties

definitions.gloss: general affairs; clerical work; miscellaneous office duties
definitions.explanation: The various routine administrative tasks in an office or organization that do not fall under a specific specialized department. Includes tasks like document management, supply ordering, facility maintenance coordination, and other day-to-day operational support.

examples.japanese: {庶務|しょむ}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please ask the person in charge of general affairs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}して→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{庶務|しょむ}⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Right after joining the company, I was assigned to the general affairs section.

examples.japanese: ⟦{備品|びひん}→備品：16253_bihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧や⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、{庶務|しょむ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多岐|たき}→多岐：12202_taki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる。
examples.english: General affairs work covers a wide range, including managing supplies and handling visitors.

notes:
Refers to the catch-all category of administrative and clerical work in an organization. {庶務|しょむ} tasks are the behind-the-scenes operational duties that keep an office running smoothly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {庶務|しょむ}⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧: general affairs section/department
- {庶務|しょむ}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: person in charge of general affairs
- {庶務|しょむ}{係|がかり}: general affairs clerk
- {庶務|しょむ}⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧: general affairs duties

TYPICAL TASKS:
{庶務|しょむ} includes tasks such as:
- ⟦{備品|びひん}→備品：16253_bihin⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: managing office supplies
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧: organizing documents
- ⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: receiving visitors
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦{応対|おうたい}→応対：04110_outai⟧: answering phone calls

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{総務|そうむ}→総務：16143_soumu⟧: general affairs (at a higher organizational level; a department name)
- ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧: office work, clerical work (broader and more general)
